chat.body: Why does EditOrderPage take the id from the URL instead of from the order it loaded?

`handleSubmit` in `EditOrderPage` spreads the draft and then sets `id: orderId` from the URL, so the request path and the body always name the same order. The loaded order has the same id, so the two only differ if the URL changes while the page is open.
